Messages.Body:
Aaron Foss <foss...@gold.tc.umn.edu> writes:

> How does the 'new' damage prevention rules. I think it was something
>like damage can only be prevented during strike resolution phase. So
>the question is can fortitude cards be used to prevent the damage given
>by Pulled Fangs. (i.e.) Blood Fury (which as everybody knows can't be
>prevented by fortitude, then Pulled Fangs).

Fortitude cards cannot be used to prevent damage from Pulled Fangs.
A Flak Jacket could, and a previously played Flesh of Marble (protean),
if superior, would work to reduce the damage from Fangs.

Messages.Author: Aaron Foss
Messages.Body:
How does the 'new' damage prevention rules. I think it was something
like damage can only be prevented during strike resolution phase. So
the question is can fortitude cards be used to prevent the damage given
by Pulled Fangs. (i.e.) Blood Fury (which as everybody knows can't be
prevented by fortitude, then Pulled Fangs).
